scope: Probe-level scoring time for already-constructed exact, retained-key-refit, and decay states. Excludes model loading, prefill, state construction, decrement/refit construction, and any full-repack comparator.
interpretation: These values characterize audit scoring cost, not deletion latency or speedup. The current verifier constructs the fixed-C_b retained-key refit before attempting decrement, and no corrected-configuration paired decrement-versus-full-repack timing benchmark exists.
